channel.title: Earnings: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New earnings filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Lotte Tour Development reported October 2026 consolidated casino revenue of KRW 62.5bn (62,526 million won), up 24.1% year on year.
GC Biopharma reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 522.1bn (5,221억원) and operating profit of KRW 49.2bn (492억원), unaudited.
SNT Dynamics reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 143.6bn and operating profit of KRW 6.1bn, down 69.5% year on year.
SNT Holdings reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 454.6bn (4,545.89억원) and operating profit of KRW 45.1bn (450.70억원), both down year on year.
POSCO Steeleon posted Q3 2026 operating loss of KRW 0.3bn (-3억원) on revenue of KRW 281.0bn (2,810억원), per preliminary separate results.
POSCO Steeleon reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 285.2bn (2,852억원) and operating profit of KRW 0.2bn (2억원), with a net loss.
SNT Energy reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 100.8bn and operating profit of KRW 17.6bn, with a net loss of KRW 7.4bn.
DI Corp's preliminary Q3 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 217.7bn (2,177.20억원), up 99.6% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 59.3bn (593.43억원).
Lotte Innovate reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 284.0bn and operating profit of KRW 12.4bn, with a net loss of KRW 7.1bn.
Cosmo Advanced Materials reported Q3 2026 standalone revenue of KRW 144.1bn, up 36.9% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 1.8bn.
